title: Linear Landau damping at k = 0.5
shows: A small density wave (k·λ_D = 0.5) in a Maxwellian plasma damps without collisions; the electric field decays at γ = −0.1533 ω_p. The solver's first-order upwind steps add damping that falls with the cell size: on 512 cells across the wave it is within 4 %.
source: Root of the Vlasov–Poisson dispersion relation: J. Canosa, J. Comput. Phys. 13 (1973) 158; used as the standard test in E. Sonnendrücker, Numerical Methods for the Vlasov–Maxwell Equations (lecture notes, 2015).
